description: This file defines the UploadedFile class which implements the UploadedFileInterface, managing file upload handling, including error states and moving uploaded files, within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file, implementing the UploadedFileInterface, with methods to access upload details, move the file, and manage errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile object with stream, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: setStreamOrFile
methods.description: Private method to set internal stream or file resource based on input.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Validates and sets the upload error status.

methods.name: isStringNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a given parameter is a non-empty string.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Checks if the upload has no errors.

methods.name: isMoved
methods.description: Indicates if the file has been moved.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Ensures the upload is valid and not already moved before file operations.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream representing the uploaded file.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file, if available.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the client-supplied filename for upload.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the client-supplied media type for upload.
